test_mnist_dataset_sizes: test the mnist Dataset class to verify num_classes, num_train_examples, and num_test_examples return correct values
test_mnist_randomize_labels: test the mnist Dataset randomize_labels method to verify partial and full label randomization with a given seed
test_mnist_subsample: test the mnist Dataset subsample method to verify it reduces dataset size by the specified fraction with a given seed
test_mnist_subsample_twice_error: test that calling subsample twice on the same mnist Dataset instance raises a ValueError
test_mnist_get_sets: test that mnist Dataset get_test_set and get_train_set return non-None dataset objects
